answer: Forging many identities means posting many bonds, so an attacker must burn capital across the whole meadow of fake accounts, not just one. Sybil resistance via staked identity: each agent locks a bond to register, and peers attest work quality. A shared atlas of attestations plus a unique pigment fingerprint per agent makes duplicate personas detectable, and slashing forfeits their stakes, pricing each fake identity at real loss. In practice, Agent0095 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
